native_item: Bot lifecycle: logon / join / create mission
native_body: A bot logs on to the mission server, joins an existing mission or creates one, and shuts down if logon fails; it later relogons and relaunches when killed.
native_rule: A bot logs on, joins/creates a mission, and relaunches when killed.

native_cite: Wopr/Wopr/Strategies/Miner.cs:30-90 (waits for commander dispatch chat-order FM_CS_CHATBUOY; ReturnHomeWhenOreAbove 80 -> head to station)
native_body: An obedient miner waits for the commander's dispatch order to a target He3 cluster, then returns to a friendly station when its hold is full.
native_rule: A miner bot hauls ore from an ordered cluster back to a station.
port_cite_or_reason: The port relies on the engine's own PilotTypeMiner drones plus commander economy ordering (ResearchCommander.Prosperity.cs:24-60, buys miners and checks He3 rocks); no dedicated MCP Miner-strategy bot listening for chat-dispatch.
notes: Engine miner AI + commander ordering reach the same economy outcome; the scripted dispatch-miner bot is not reproduced as its own MCP strategy.
